test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statement.

**Statements:**

All paintings are arts

Some walls are doors

Some paintings are windows

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some arts are walls

(II) Some arts are windows

(III) Some paintings are doors
solution:
Given statements:

All paintings are arts

Some walls are doors

Some paintings are windows

The least possible diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d1fbb7245e521ef4c4360517ecc2f14f8df767c76d2127d4dac3f2d9592288e.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some arts are walls - False (Because, there is no relation between arts and walls, so it can be possible only)

(II) Some arts are windows - True (Because, All paintings are arts and Some paintings are windows implies that Some arts are windows)

(III) Some paintings are doors - False (Because, there is no relation between paintings and doors, so it can be possible only)

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
